title: Arizona parents win appeal after HOA blocks gate change for disabled son's golf cart access
summary_full: In a significant ruling, an Arizona couple, Kevin and Jennifer LoPresto, sought to replace their single gate with a wider double gate to accommodate their disabled son's golf cart. The Wigwam Creek South Community Association rejected their request and pushed for arbitration. However, an appeals court sided with the LoPrestos, allowing their lawsuit against the HOA to continue and awarding them reasonable legal fees for the appeals process.
